nodes.label: EGF
props: EGF stimulates the growth of various epidermal and epithelial tissues in vivo and in vitro and of some fibroblasts in cell culture. Magnesiotropic hormone that stimulates magnesium reabsorption in the renal distal convoluted tubule via engagement of EGFR and activation of the magnesium channel TRPM6.

nodes.label: EGFR
props: Proto-oncogene c-ErbB-1; Receptor tyrosine-protein kinase erbB-1

Receptor tyrosine kinase binding ligands of the EGF family and activating several signaling cascades to convert extracellular cues into appropriate cellular responses. Known ligands include EGF, TGFA/TGF-alpha, AREG, epigen/EPGN, BTC/betacellulin, epiregulin/EREG and HBEGF/heparin-binding EGF.

nodes.label: GRB2
props: Adapter protein GRB2; Protein Ash; SH2/SH3 adapter GRB2

Non-enzymatic adapter protein that plays a pivotal role in precisely regulated signaling cascades from cell surface receptors to cellular responses, including signaling transduction and gene expression. Thus, participates in many biological processes including regulation of innate and adaptive immunity, autophagy, DNA repair or necroptosis.

nodes.label: SOS1
props: Promotes the exchange of Ras-bound GDP by GTP. Probably by promoting Ras activation, regulates phosphorylation of MAP kinase MAPK3/ERK1 in response to EGF.

nodes.label: NF1
props: Stimulates the GTPase activity of Ras. NF1 shows greater affinity for Ras GAP, but lower specific activity.

nodes.label: RASA1
props: GTPase-activating protein (GAP) that stimulates the intrinsic GTPase activity of Ras proteins, such as NRAS, facilitating their transition from the active GTP-bound state to the inactive GDP-bound state, thereby terminating Ras signaling
